a set of essential standardized tests is proposed for evaluation of neural interface electrodes, and that the proposed tests are based on a critical analysis of the most relevant tests available in the literature.

the performance of neural interface electrodes should be evaluated by the following tests: (1) impedance spectroscopy, (2) charge transfer, (3) cyclic voltammetry, (4) charge injection limit and (5) electrochemistry.
